sets.name: Marine VHF Intl
sets.description: The ITU international marine VHF channels for listening: duplex channels receive the coast side. Leaves out DSC (70), AIS, ASM, 2006 and the digital-only channels.

source.title: ITU Radio Regulations, Edition of 2024, Vol. 2, Appendix 18 (Rev.WRC-19)

sets.name: Air Emergency
sets.description: The worldwide aeronautical emergency, search and rescue and oceanic air-to-air channels, AM.

sets.name: ISS
sets.description: The ISS amateur radio channels at their nominal frequencies; correct for Doppler by hand (about 3.5 kHz on 2 m, 10 kHz on 70 cm), or use the satellite screen.

source.title: ARISS: Contact the ISS (Frequencies in use)
ARISS: Current Status of ISS Stations

frequencies.name: ISS Voice R1
frequencies.note: Crew voice; uplink for ITU Region 1

frequencies.name: ISS Voice R2/R3
frequencies.note: Crew voice; uplink for Regions 2 and 3

sets.name: FM Satellites
sets.description: Long-running FM repeater satellites with fixed channels: receive the downlink, transmit the uplink. Nominal frequencies; correct for Doppler or use the satellite screen.

source.title: AMSAT: FM Satellites frequency summary
